members.speakLineEn: She handled the live microphone failure with aplomb, joking until the backup cable arrived.
members.speakLineZh: 她沉著自信地應付現場麥克風故障，一路開玩笑直到備用線抵達。

members.speakLineEn: Years of ballet gave her the poise to walk across the icy plaza without a single slip.
members.speakLineZh: 多年芭蕾賦予她鎮定平衡，能走過結冰廣場而不滑倒一次。

related.synonyms: aplomb, assuredness, cool, sang-froid, brace, balance
related.antonyms: heat, warm, de-energise, de-energize, sedate, asymmetry, imbalance, unbalance

members.speakLineEn: One late free throw would clinch the championship and send the bench storming the court.
members.speakLineZh: 一記關鍵罰球就能敲定冠軍，讓替補席衝進球場。

members.speakLineEn: The coach's unequivocal demand was simple: no phones on the bench during playoff games.
members.speakLineZh: 教練明確清晰的要求很簡單：季後賽期間板凳席禁止手機。

members.speakLineEn: Her categorical refusal to sign left the contract sitting unsigned on the conference table.
members.speakLineZh: 她斷然絕對的拒絕簽字，讓合約仍攤在會議桌上。

members.speakLineEn: A decisive vote in the morning session ended weeks of deadlock over the budget amendment.
members.speakLineZh: 上午場一場決定性投票，結束了預算修正案數週的僵局。

members.speakLineEn: The fingerprint match made his presence at the scene an indubitable fact for the jury.
members.speakLineZh: 指紋吻合讓他在場成為陪審團毋庸置疑的事實。

members.speakLineEn: Please enunciate each syllable clearly so the remote students can follow the new formula.
members.speakLineZh: 請把每個音節清晰闡述，讓遠距學生跟得上新公式。

related.synonyms: pronounce, articulate, enounce, say, vocalize, vocalise

members.speakLineEn: Investors stayed skeptical until the prototype survived a full week of outdoor stress tests.
members.speakLineZh: 投資人保持懷疑，直到原型撐過整整一週的戶外壓力測試。

members.speakLineEn: Shoppers grew leery of the too-good coupon after three stores refused to honor it.
members.speakLineZh: 三家店都拒絕兌換後，顧客對那張好得過頭的折價券開始猜疑。

members.speakLineEn: Their alibi rested on a tenuous claim that both phones had died at the exact same minute.
members.speakLineZh: 他們的不在場證明建立在脆弱牽強的說法上：兩支手機同一分鐘沒電。

members.speakLineEn: A fog of incertitude hung over the election night desk as rural counties delayed returns.
members.speakLineZh: 鄉下郡延遲開票時，一層不確定的迷霧籠罩選情夜播報台。

members.speakLineEn: She faced a quandary: miss the interview or leave her feverish brother home alone.
members.speakLineZh: 她陷入困窘：要麼錯過面試，要麼把發燒的弟弟獨自留在家。

members.speakLineEn: Don't dither over font choices while the printer deadline is already twenty minutes past.
members.speakLineZh: 印刷截止已過二十分鐘，別再為字體選擇猶豫不決。

members.speakLineEn: His voice did not falter when he told the room that the funding had been withdrawn overnight.
members.speakLineZh: 他告訴全場經費一夜之間被撤時，聲音沒有蹣跚猶豫。

related.synonyms: hesitation, waver, faltering, stumble, bumble, stutter

members.speakLineEn: Blaming the power outage on migrating birds sounded far-fetched even to patient neighbors.
members.speakLineZh: 把停電怪到候鳥頭上，連有耐心的鄰居都覺得牽強不可信。

members.speakLineEn: Two lab runs remained inconclusive, so the team scheduled a third trial under brighter light.
members.speakLineZh: 兩次實驗仍沒有定論，團隊安排在更亮燈光下做第三次試驗。

members.speakLineEn: The ladder leaned at a precarious angle against the wet gutter, swaying with every breeze.
members.speakLineZh: 梯子以危險不穩的角度靠在濕水槽上，每陣風都晃。

members.speakLineEn: Candle flames began to waver as the draft slipped through the cracked window frame.
members.speakLineZh: 穿堂風從裂開的窗框溜入時，燭火開始動搖晃動。

members.speakLineEn: Accept the internship offer with one caveat: unpaid overtime cannot become the default.
members.speakLineZh: 接受實習offer時要有一則告誡：無薪加班不能變成常態。

members.speakLineEn: On the origin of the rumor she remained agnostic, refusing to endorse either camp's story.
members.speakLineZh: 對於謠言起源她保持不可知論態度，拒絕站任一陣營的說法。

members.speakLineEn: The sticker price alone made him boggle, and he quietly returned the camera to its shelf.
members.speakLineZh: 光是標價就讓他猶豫驚呆，悄悄把相機放回架上。

members.speakLineEn: Facing two equally urgent deadlines made her stagger between tasks without finishing either.
members.speakLineZh: 面對兩個同樣緊急的截止日，她猶豫不決地在任務間踱步，哪個都完不成。

members.speakLineEn: Do not tarry in the hallway after the drill bell; teachers need a clear path to the exits.
members.speakLineZh: 演練鈴響後別在走廊逗留等候；老師需要暢通的逃生通道。

related.synonyms: loiter, lounge, footle, lollygag, loaf, lallygag

members.speakLineEn: A faint suspicion that the invoice was duplicated sent the accountant back through last week's mail.
members.speakLineZh: 一絲懷疑發票被重複開立，讓會計又翻回上週郵件。

related.synonyms: intuition, hunch, misgiving, mistrust, distrust, suspiciousness
